_meta.purpose: Public deny-list (axis-B) for leak_linter.py. Contains generic secret-pattern detectors (BLOCK) and upstream-name / mempalace-taxonomy overlap warnings (WARN). Safe to commit to the public repo -- contains no real identifiers.
_meta.location_invariant: This file (leak_linter_denylist.public.json) and leak_linter.py belong in tools/ inside the public repo tree. The private deny-list (axis-A, real identifiers) is a separate file that must never be committed here.
_meta.axis: Axis-B rules only. Axis-A rules (real personas, paths, infra, schema) live in the private deny-list which is never shipped.

severity_semantics.BLOCK: generic secret pattern detected (API token, private key, bare hash) -> exit code 2; merge blocked
severity_semantics.WARN: upstream-name overlap or mempalace taxonomy without attribution marker -> informational; does not change exit code

_meta.tuning_notes: Regex Python (re). flags: 'i'=IGNORECASE. exempt_regex optional: if it matches the containing line, the hit is suppressed. Run with --public --redact-matches in CI.

internal_artifacts._note: Assert-absent tripwires. Files with these basenames must never appear in the public repo tree. Presence is a BLOCK (exit 2), not a scan-skip. Includes the private deny-list filenames so that accidentally committing them is caught by public CI.

block.note: bare 64-char hex is likely a SHA-256 baseline or pin
bare 40-char hex is likely a SHA-1 baseline or pin
8+ char hex adjacent to a pin/hash context keyword

upstream_names._note: WARN 'upstream-name-overlap'. Fires when a staging file basename or its content matches a name from the freskhu/genesis upstream tree. Universal OSS filenames are exempt (see ignore_universal). Non-blocking: demands conscious acknowledgment.

mempalace_terms._note: WARN 'mempalace-taxonomy-unattributed'. Fires when a mempalace taxonomy term appears in a file that has no acknowledgment marker anywhere on the page. Non-blocking: demands conscious attribution.
